text:
Arugula salad with some walnuts and light dressing, plus a few cauliflower florets. Greens about 40 g, cauliflower about 80 g, walnuts about 8 g, dressing about 10 g, for roughly 140 g total. Energy: greens about 10 kcal, cauliflower about 20 kcal, walnuts about 50 kcal, dressing (oil) about 60 kcal, for about 140 kcal.
